Defeat [[Dhuum]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
<!-- Quest objectives copied verbatim from in-game -->
* Engage [[Dhuum]] in the [[Hall of Judgment]]. Your entire party must enter the hall.
*Protect the Reapers while they channel all their energy into Dhuum's Rest, a powerful enchantment developed to force Dhuum into dormancy. At least one Reaper must survive. There are 7..1 Reapers still standing.
*Lay Dhuum low so the Reapers' magic can force Dhuum into dormancy.
*See [[King Frozenwind]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 Experience
* 1,000 gold

== Walkthrough ==

;The Arena
While facing Dhuum, if you [[death|die]] or your [[Death Penalty|death penalty]] hits 60%, you will be moved next to [[Mayor Alegheri]] in the [[Forgotten Vale]] and turned into [[Spirit Form (disguise)|Spirit Form]]. [[Player]]s must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; [[hero]]es are returned automatically. [[Consumable]]s that [[Death_penalty#Death_Penalty_removal|remove death penalty]] or grant a [[Morale Boost]] can prevent this.

Death in Spirit Form is supposed to be permanent, since the [[Curse of Dhuum]] prevents the use of [[resurrect]]ion skills during this battle. But [[Scroll of Resurrection|resurrection scrolls]] and [["By Ural's Hammer!"]] still work, as does pre-casting delayed resurrection skills like [[Unyielding Aura]] ''before'' entering the room.

;The Fight
There are two goals in this battle. One is to fill the ''Dhuum's Rest'' bar, which is achieved gradually with the skill [[Dhuum's Rest]] used by the [[Reaper]]s and by players in Spirit Form. The other is to damage Dhuum directly, bringing him below 25% health. When both goals are met, the fight is over and you can collect the reward from King Frozenwind.

Throughout the battle, make sure to kill all of the [[Minion of Dhuum|Minions of Dhuum]] and [[Champion of Dhuum|Champions of Dhuum]] that Dhuum periodically summons; if you don't kill them, they'll swarm your team. Because of the amount of skeletons and the easiness of killing them, [[Edge of Extinction]] is a good tool for keeping their numbers down. Avoid using the spirit form skill [[Encase Skeletal]], since it prevents the target from taking damage; as more and more come it gets harder to keep them all in check and easier for them to swarm.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;King Frozenwind
:''"The moment we have long dreaded has arrived! Dhuum is breaking free from the Hall of Judgment! Should he seize control of the Underworld, Dhuum's reign will be brutal and uncompromising, for he is the Final Death, and he does not tolerate resurrections or the undead. There is still one slim hope, a shadow of a chance to hinder Dhuum's return. Grenth's seven faithful Reapers will channel their energy in an attempt to force Dhuum back into dormancy. But the Ender of All is a powerful adversary, and the Reapers cannot face him alone. Protect the Reapers while they perform their grim task. At least one of the seven Reapers must survive to seal Dhuum within the Hall of Judgment."''
:''"Should you perish in this conflict with Dhuum, do not despair, for your spirit may still contribute to the battle. Mayor Alegheri can speed your spirit's return to the Hall of Judgment, where you may rejoin the fray and assist the Reapers."''
:''"The fate of the Underworld depends upon your success! Now you must face Dhuum. I will be here...if you return."''
